jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
Legitimerad lärare i textilslöjd åk 4-9

IES Österåker öppnade i augusti 2024 och är en modern F-9skola med höga ambitioner. När skolan är fullbelagd kommer vi att ha cirka 600 elever fördelade på två parallellklasser per årskurs.

Vi följer den svenska läroplanen och upp till 50 procent av undervisningen sker på engelska. Vår verksamhet präglas av tydlig struktur, höga akademiska förväntningar och en trygg studiemiljö där både elever och personal trivs och utvecklas.

Skolan ligger centralt i Åkersberga i en kombination av nybyggda och renoverade lokaler. Med närhet till idrottsanläggningar, grönområden och skärgård erbjuder vi en inspirerande arbetsmiljö, ca 30 minuters pendling från Stockholm.

Vi söker nu en legitimerad lärare i textilslöjd för årskurs 4–9 som vill vara med och göra skillnad varje dag.

Som lärare hos oss ansvarar du för planering, undervisning, bedömning och uppföljning i enlighet med Lgr22. Du arbetar aktivt för att utveckla elevernas kreativitet, problemlösningsförmåga och hantverksmässiga kunskaper inom textila tekniker och skapande processer.

Du skapar en inspirerande och trygg lärmiljö där eleverna får möjlighet att utveckla både självständighet och samarbetsförmåga genom praktiskt och kreativt arbete.

I tjänsten ingår även mentorskap, där du har en central roll i elevernas kunskapsmässiga och sociala utveckling. Du har nära kontakt med vårdnadshavare och samarbetar tätt med kollegor, elevhälsoteam och skolledning.

Arbetsro är viktigt för oss. Vi har tydliga rutiner och en gemensam värdegrund som skapar trygghet och studiefokus i klassrummet. Det ger dig som lärare rätt förutsättningar att fokusera på undervisning och kunskapsutveckling.

Vi söker dig som 

- är legitimerad lärare i textilslöjd för åk 4–9
- har ett tydligt ledarskap och skapar struktur och studiero
- har höga förväntningar på dina elever och en stark tilltro till deras förmåga
- är engagerad, lösningsfokuserad och trivs med att samarbeta
- ger tydlig och kontinuerlig återkoppling som driver elevernas utveckling framåt

Du är trygg i din profession och varierar din undervisning för att möta olika elevers behov. Du arbetar inkluderande och ser samarbete med elevhälsa och kollegor som en självklar del av uppdraget.

Du har god kunskap om material, verktyg och arbetsprocesser inom textilslöjd samt förmåga att inspirera elever till kreativitet och skaparglädje.

Vi erbjuder: 

- En arbetsplats med tydlig struktur och starkt ledarskap
- Engagerade kollegor och internationell miljö
- Möjlighet att vara med och forma en växande skola
- En kultur med höga ambitioner, arbetsro och fokus på kunskap

Tjänsten är på 80% med sex månaders provanställning, men kan utökas till 100% för rätt kandidat med relevant kompetens och erfarenhet. 

Intervjuer sker löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Utdrag ur belastningsregistret är obligatoriskt vid anställning.

Would you like to work in a meaningful role where you will plan, organize, and deliver a wide range of on-site and digital events while making a real difference in people’s lives? At Connecting Jobs, you will become an important part of a non-profit organization dedicated to support, inclusion, and social impact.
Connecting Jobs, part of Beredskapslyftet, is looking for an Event Coordinator to coordinate and deliver a variety of digital and on-site events, from educational activities to recruitment initiatives. Connecting Jobs helps newcomers in Sweden enter the labor market. By collaborating with committed employers and partners, we build bridges between skills and opportunities, creating meaningful connections that benefit both individuals and businesses.
In this role you will take ownership of each event from initial planning to final follow-up, ensuring that every detail is in place and each event achieves its objectives. You will also provide the organizational, administrative, and marketing support needed to make our events successful and engaging.
This is a 75% fixed-term position with start as soon as possible until the end of February 2027, based in central Stockholm.
Key responsibilities:
Take responsibility for the full event organization process, from promoting events on social media to preparing the event schedule, badges, banners, registration forms, and other materials
For events, shortlist candidates and manage communication with them before and after the event
Confirm participants, host and support speakers, and handle the necessary event agreements and documents
Give presentations to audiences in both Swedish and English
Provide technical, organizational, and marketing support during events
Run and coordinate digital events in Microsoft Teams
Support the production of handouts and branded visual materials for events
Keep marketing materials and event equipment in order and order new supplies in advance
Plan and manage event budgets
Keep in contact with participants and collect their feedback
Analyze the effectiveness of completed events and suggest improvements
Report to the Community Lead and provide event reports as needed.

Requirements (mandatory):
Fluent Swedish, spoken and written
English at upper-intermediate level or higher
Proven experience in creating and running events, both physical and digital
Experience in public speaking in both Swedish and English, for example hosting, moderating or presenting at events.

Your profile:
You have strong organizational and administrative skills
You have ability to stay calm and act quickly in unexpected situations during events, such as speaker cancellations, technical failures, or last-minute venue changes
You follow established business processes and rules
You are solution-oriented, have ability to overcome obstacles, and find ways to get tasks done
You have well-developed communication skills, both oral and written.

What we offer:
Fixed-term employment at 75% of full-time, until the end of February 2027
Office working hours
An office in central Stockholm with possibility to work remotely from home from time to time
Opportunities to travel and flexibility to adjust working hours when events require it.

Location:
Olof Palmes gata, Stockholm, with the possibility of hybrid working.

You play an important part in taking Klarna to the next level, working across sales lifecycle areas, financial planning, and stakeholder communication. You bring a "Swiss army knife" mindset, ready to move between problems and provide data-driven guidance wherever it is needed.

Who you are
- A degree from a university in a numerate subject, such as Economics, Science, Engineering, or Business
- At least 5 years of analytical experience in retail banking, e-commerce, or payments, with knowledge of consumer lending in western countries preferred
- Strong general knowledge of the sales lifecycle, with deep expertise in one area such as credit risk, product/UX, marketing analytics, accounting, pricing, or data
- Experience supporting sales and marketing efforts, such as merchant sales strategies or campaign impact analysis
- Financial analytics experience, including business planning, budgeting, forecasting, and KPI tracking
- Strong communication skills, with the ability to engage external stakeholders; merchant-facing experience is a plus
- Working proficiency and communication skills in verbal and written English

Awesome to have
- Strong attention to detail and experience using structured approaches to problem solving
- Understanding of regional risk policies and risk profiles, with the ability to suggest or build merchant-specific policy adjustments
- Significant drive and ambition
- Strong conceptual ability
- Familiarity with data extraction and manipulation, and programming languages such as SQL, R, Python, MatLab, Java, or C#
Please include a CV in English
Curious to learn more about Klarna and what it's like to work here? Explore our career site: https://www.klarna.com/careers/

jobs.employer_name: Internationella Engelska Skolan i Sverige AB
jobs.description:
IES Linköping opened in 2003 and offers a bilingual education to 550 students between grades F-9 and a fulfilling career opportunity for around 80 employees.

At IES Linköping we make a difference in the lives of our students. Our students master the English language in a positive environment of high expectations. We believe a safe and structured school is essential for the best possible social and academic development. We follow Swedish school law, teaching and setting grades according to Lgr 22 and we are proud of our diverse and engaged multicultural school.

We are looking for an Assistant Principal (AP) for grades 6-9 to join our leadership team, who will support the Principal in leading and creating the opportunity for every student to realise their own potential in an international environment. The AP position involves being a member of the Senior Management Team, and having staff responsibility, for instance managing both the Student Care Team functions and the Heads of Year. We are looking for candidates who can lead, manage and train their staff to ensure that students experience consistency, within a caring and supportive school environment.

The position:

- Collaborate with the Principal and other school leaders in the overall development of the school, its culture, strategy, structure and routines
- Monitor, follow up on and develop the quality of the planning, teaching, assessment and grading
- Lead and coach our team of Middle Leaders who in turn lead their teams
- Plan and lead professional development for staff
- Monitor, follow up on and develop our students’ learning and behavioral outcomes (Systematic Quality Work)
- Collaborate with other school leaders around academic and social support structures to ensure our resources are used effectively
- Lead development, appraisal and salary talks

About you:

- We are looking for someone who is passionate about education and creating a climate for learning and you have the ability to engage and inspire both students and staff
- You are a competent and enthusiastic role model and leader with a strong presence to help us continue to develop the teaching, learning & behavior
- You are a committed, strategic, positive and reliable team player and are capable of developing ideas, leading teams and coaching individuals. You also work operatively as an individual
- You promote bilingualism, have an international mindset and approach, exercise cultural intelligence and good interpersonal skills
- You are a qualified teacher or possess equivalent leadership experience within a school environment, coupled with a proven track record of student success
- You have a proven track record in student care and academics, and leadership experience including staff responsibility
- You are able to work professionally in both English and Swedish in meetings and presentations

Support:

- A strong and supportive leadership team, introduction & mentorship by the Principal
- Additional leadership training, including the possibility to do UK Senior Leadership Training and later the Swedish Principal training, once established in the role
- Monthly digital meetings and physical day conferences with other Academic Leaders from around IES
- Positive, proactive and constructive school culture
- Clear routines and systems for how we work

Opportunity

- 100% position leading to permanency; 40-hour work week
- Collective agreement with ALMEGA & additional pension payment & additional holiday days
- A transparent, positive and constructive work environment
- IES offers a wide range of social activities, career opportunities and professional development

Want to find out more?

- Watch an Introduction to IES and read what it is like to work with us
- Visit our webpage and instagram “ies_linkoping” 

A personal letter, copies of qualifications and CV should be sent to  recruitment.linkoping@engelska.se, citing  "Assistant Principal" in the subject line. 

References are required and the position starts spring term 2027 or as agreed.

Internationella Engelska Skolan (IES) is a leading independent school group with academic results far above average and a diverse and energetic staff. Teaching is in both Swedish and English, and the hallways are bilingual. The language of meetings and communication amongst the staff is English.

IES is one of Sweden's largest school groups at compulsory school level with 46 schools and around 30,000 students across the country. IES has grown steadily and maintained quality since 1993.

N.B. Prior to any offer of employment at IES, a criminal background check is required for all applicants. In Sweden, this is an extract from belastningsregistret from Polismyndigheten and from abroad, this is a record extract from an equivalent police governing body.
